title: DevOps Engineer for Document Management - (m/f/d)
description:
**WELCOME TO BASF**
 At BASF Digital Hub Hyderabad we develop innovative digital solutions for BASF, create new exciting customer experiences and business growth, and drive efficiencies in processes, helping to strengthen BASF´s position as the digital leader in the chemical industry. We believe the right path is through creativity, trial and error and great people working and learning together. Become part of our team and develop the future with us \- in a global team that embraces diversity and equal opportunities.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly motivated Document Management Application expert \& Data Migration Specialist to join our global Enterprise Information Management team. In this role, you will be handling all the demands that will come from Asia, supporting the onboarding of new use cases, enhancements, and migration initiatives on the Documentum platform.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Design, implement and evolve solutions in our Document management system (currently Documentum).
* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to solution design decisions.
* Support enterprise initiatives related to application decommissioning, legacy modernization, and archive consolidation.
* Designing and deliver custom ETL solutions, including scripts, services, and reusable frameworks to address complex or non‑standard migration scenarios
* CI/CD implementation using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions


**Core Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar
* Extensive experience with Documentum integrations and cutomizations using different APIs: DFC, REST, D2\-REST, DFS…. Deep knowledge on Documentum architecture, Data model and related products.
* Knowledge of other Document Management Systems (DMS) will be valued
* Programming skills in Java and C\#
* Hands‑on experience with end‑to‑end ETL processes, including analysis, extraction, transformation, validation, migration, and reconciliation of enterprise content and metadata
* CI/CD implementation using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions
* Containerization and deployment with Docker, Kubernetes, or similar technologies
* Strong background in Agile methodologies
* Strong problem\-solving mindset and ability to work in a collaborative, cross\-functional environment
* Fluent English, both written and spoken


**What We Offer**
 Be part of a global leader in digital transformation, working in a vibrant Digital Hub that values innovation, agility, and cross\-functional collaboration. Shape the future of BASF’s digital landscape, contributing to projects that drive sustainability and make a real impact. Thrive in a high\-performance culture that supports your personal and professional growth, offering diverse learning opportunities and career development. Enjoy a modern, inclusive work environment where your ideas are valued, and your curiosity and ambition are encouraged. Benefit from flexible working models, international networking, and a strong sense of purpose as we enable our customers’ green transformation and lead the way in digital excellence.
